facts: Parties: Thornbury Logistics plc (Buyer), Kingsmere Pharma plc (Seller); the Company is Corrib Bioscience plc.
This Agreement is dated 5 July 2026; Closing is scheduled for 25 August 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $3,500,000.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Pemberton Retail Group plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $3,150,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $204,300,000.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $6,100,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $4,600,000.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Arden Industries Ltd.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Hartwell Bioscience plc threatening proceedings for approximately $1,200,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
